description: prompt_async returned 204 but no admission event received within the deadline. No retry because the bare prompt API does not prove idempotency for palliumRelayId.

expected_protocol_sequence.note: Transport ACK; no admission event follows.

expected_protocol_sequence.reason: Bare prompt_async idempotency not proven; retry risks double delivery.

idempotency_note: Retry requires runtime-side idempotency proof independent of history visibility. A plugin coordinator history scan does not provide that proof: an accepted prompt_async may not yet appear in session history, so a second scan returning no match can produce a duplicate turn. Retry remains disabled until the OpenCode runtime exposes an explicit idempotency guarantee.
